The number sits with the notification icons on the top row. Pull the shade down to see download and upload together.
On a Galaxy, also set this app to unrestricted battery, or Samsung may stop it after a restart.
Notifications have to stay on, or Android will not keep the icon in the status bar.
To come back after a restart, allow unrestricted battery.
Samsung freezes background work unless battery use for this app is set to unrestricted.

Shows download and upload speed. Leave this notification on so the icon can stay in the status bar.

The number is a status bar icon in the notification area. Android does not let an app draw beside the clock or the battery.

One UI usually keeps only three notification icons. If the row is full, this one can be pushed out.

To keep it visible:
1. Allow notifications for this app.
2. In phone settings, open Notifications, then advanced settings, and show status bar icons rather than only a count.
3. In this app's battery settings, choose unrestricted.

On Wi-Fi the speed is Wi-Fi traffic. On cellular it is cellular traffic. A VPN can make that split less exact.

If the icon is too small, show only download or only upload.

You can also add a quick settings tile: pull the shade all the way down, edit the buttons, and drag Network speed in.
